name: causeline
description: Root-cause analysis you can audit: find where, when and why a KPI changed, from your own data, with every number from a deterministic analysis. Build a setup by conversation, check it against your own reports, and ask questions.
long_description: Causeline answers 'why did this number change?' with a deterministic analysis and explains it in plain words, using only numbers from the analysis. It builds the setup from your own files or BigQuery table by conversation, checks each KPI against numbers from your own reports, and reads the data in fixed ways for questions no expert covers (always labelled exploratory). Your work is saved in named projects in a folder you choose. The first time it needs to read data it fetches the data connection software (about 150 to 320 MB) and checks it before use.

projects_folder.title: Where to keep your projects
projects_folder.description: A folder for your Causeline projects and the data connection software it fetches the first time. The default is fine for most people.
